extension.title: Resource extension
extension.x-meido-game-usage: The dispatcher uses it to select the plain-JSON resource path.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: CsvManager loads .nson resources as TextAsset.text and parses the enabled-list JSON with JsonUtility; this profile does not claim a domain schema for arbitrary resource fields.

json.description: The parsed JSON value exposed for editing.
json.title: Normalized JSON value
json.x-meido-edit-guidance: Change only keys documented by the specific resource or game feature; preserve unknown members and types.
json.x-meido-game-usage: CsvManager passes the original JSON text to the consuming resource code; this library does not infer the domain schema.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: CsvManager loads .nson resources as TextAsset.text and parses the enabled-list JSON with JsonUtility; this profile does not claim a domain schema for arbitrary resource fields.

text.description: The source text retained for byte-preserving output when the normalized JSON is unchanged.
text.title: Original JSON text
text.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep text when no semantic edit is made; regenerate valid UTF-8 JSON after an intentional edit.
text.x-meido-game-usage: The game reads TextAsset.text, so whitespace and encoding may matter to external tools even when JSON semantics are unchanged.
